method: Manual reading of every native-schema response (12 accepted, 3 rejected; rejected text is in requests.jsonl). Structured quantities were compared with every quantity stated in instruction or message prose. Availability is judged against the documented Task 6.2 policy (user-listed ingredients plus water, salt, black pepper and oil). That policy is not implemented in this checkout, so the current prompts only say 'available ingredients and basic pantry staples only'. Nothing was cooked.
